title: Vampire Bats Starve in Three Days, So Why Do They Feed Strangers?
subject: vampire bat

scenes.text: Vampire bats starve if they miss meals for three days. So why do they share?
A bat that finds blood can bring some back up to feed a hungry roostmate.
They help close relatives, but also unrelated bats at risk of starving.
Researchers kept 27 bats together for 15 months. Grooming always came before food sharing.
Bats that had fed many non-relatives got helped the most when food ran short.
The bat that shares blood today is buying itself a meal tomorrow.

description:
Vampire bats must eat every three days, yet they share blood with unrelated roostmates.
A 15-month study found grooming comes first, and bats with many friends are helped most when food runs short.
Would you share your last meal?
